verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a hosted memory and context-graph service, but the evidence never documents a bulk export of users, threads, or graphs in open formats. What the pack does show is adjacent: deletion and right-to-be-forgotten APIs, a CLI for vague 'data operations', an open-source Graphiti framework, VPC deployment, and an inbound Mem0 migration guide. None of these is an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
